30. COMMITMENTS AND CONTINGENCIES (Cont’)
(c) Contingent Assets
Industry dispute
The company is involved in a dispute with other oil companies over the price to be applied for the re-invoicing of November
2004 industry crude import which was shipped by the company under the contractual arrangements of the Open Tender
System (OTS). The matter was determined in the company’s favour but other oil companies have lodged an appeal and the
matter referred for arbitration. The company directors and legal advisers are of the opinion that the final decision will be in
the company’s favour. The total amount in dispute over the tender is Kshs 106 million, which has been fully provided for in
the financial statements.
Dispute with a supplier
The company is also involved in a dispute with a supplier over the non delivery of product paid for but not received. The net
exposure of Kshs 171 million has been fully provided for in the financial statements.
